messages.plaintextBody:
Hi James,

Confirming the viewing at 2pm tomorrow for the two-bed at Flat 4, Wharfedale Court. The current tenant will be out. Let me know if your client wants the parking space included — it's an extra £40/month.

Cheers
Greg
Meridian Letting
